title: National New Generation AI Innovation and Development Pilot Zones
title_original: 国家新一代人工智能创新发展试验区
summary: Ministry of Science and Technology programme under work guidelines first issued in 2019 and revised in 2020 (Guokefagui [2020] No. 254). Cities, mainly municipalities and sub-provincial and prefecture-level cities, apply to host pilot zones. The zones run AI application demonstrations and policy experiments on data, intellectual property, ethics, talent and finance, plus long-term social experiments on AI's effects. Applicants need a core AI industry above 5 billion yuan and related industries above 20 billion yuan. The revised guidelines aimed for about 20 zones by 2023. Shenzhen and Suzhou are among the cities approved.
beneficiaries: Host cities, AI firms and research institutions in pilot zones
